tests.name: Account deletion removes every member file at every depth
tests.reason: The only way to exercise request-account-deletion is to irreversibly delete a real account in the production Supabase project that staging shares. These suites run the real walk over an in-memory Storage with Supabase list() semantics on both the direct and the storage-bridge path: nested folders at every depth, more than 1000 files in one folder without offset, a stuck remove, a list error, health-reports and feedback-attachments included, and the gate that keeps the account while files remain.
